summary: Full test suite executed for Penjahit Tracker MVP. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests PASSED covering auth (register/login/admin-login/me, validation edge cases), master-data (list, add, invalid-type, auth-required), entries CRUD (create utama, create lain-only, list, today, cross-user delete forbidden, admin can delete any), and admin routes (RBAC 403 for penjahit, summary aggregation, sheet-config get/POST with JSON validation, sync-sheet). Frontend: login screen loads, tab switch works, tailor register + auto-login → beranda, form-utama screen loads with all fields/dropdowns, bottom tabs (Beranda/Riwayat/Profil) visible, admin-login → /admin/dashboard renders stats grid (Total Entri/Menit Utama/Menit Lain/Total Output), Per Penjahit cards, tanggal & tim filters, entries list, Sync ke Google Sheet button, /admin/settings loads sheet config form. Minor: React Native web console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (informational only, not blocking). Google Sheets sync correctly returns synced_to_sheet=false silently when not configured.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Comes from a library or component using the legacy pointerEvents prop; should be moved to style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Track down and fix the deprecated pointerEvents prop usage to remove console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py handles all critical concerns: bcrypt PIN/password hashing, JWT auth, RBAC via require_admin, Pydantic validation, _id exclusion on all reads, env-based Mongo/JWT config.
GET /api/entries/today falls back to UTC date when no ?tanggal is passed — frontend correctly passes local YYYY-MM-DD, so this is fine.
Admin sync-sheet returns 400 only when config missing; when configured but service account invalid it still returns 200 with failed count — acceptable UX.

server.py logger is defined AFTER _ensure_headers_sync/_get_sheets_service_sync/sync_entry_to_sheet reference it (module-level logger assigned at line 470). Since those helpers are only called at request time (after startup), it works, but the ordering is fragile — consider moving logger init above helpers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (login, register, beranda, form-utama nav, tabs, admin-login → dashboard, admin/settings)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed tailors (TEST_Zaky_<hex>, TEST_Budi_<hex>) and entries. Entries are deleted during the tests themselves (test_delete_own_entry, test_admin_can_delete_any). Users remain in DB with TEST_ prefix — harmless but can be cleaned via db.users.delete_many({'nama': {'$regex': '^TEST_'}}). UI test created UITest_<timestamp> tailor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests must be run serially (shared state across classes). Use: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. The pytest.ini defaults to -n 2 --dist loadscope which breaks state sharing across TestAuth→TestEntries→TestAdmin. If pytest.ini is updated, verify serial execution still works. Admin creds: admin/admin123 (auto-seeded on startup). Frontend admin-login testIDs: admin-username, admin-password, admin-submit (NOT the pattern used elsewhere). Google Sheets: do NOT configure with real credentials; tests correctly expect synced_to_sheet=false silently.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Backend and frontend integration verified end-to-end.
